facebook.caption:
Locals don't post about Bãi Dài. That's exactly why you should go.

No beach clubs fighting for your attention. No vendors every five steps. Just a long stretch of sand that most tourists blow past on the way to the south.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary is packed with the same spots everyone shares, swap one afternoon for this. You'll feel the difference immediately.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch how empty Bãi Dài gets on a regular afternoon. Long sand, flat water, almost nobody around. This is still Phu Quoc in 2025.
